title: Quality Of Craft
body:
![Quality of Craft text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9762c2603d98eb2d9e0187dcc3cee82c78c3a4af_0.webp)

Minecraft has many tedious features. This fixes that with chest sorting, texture changes, and game optimization.

This modpack is recommended for server gameplay.
##
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65850b34af65c1993aff831a9c7e8197e0a77658_0.webp)
- 70+ Mods to prove optimal performance and quality
- Fast tree mining with Tree Harvester
- Various sound effects
- Distant blur and shaders
- Game optimization for max performance
- Elytra Armor Slot
- New biomes and biome generation!
